criteria.text: `pdd workflow status --all --json` prints one JSON object with `schema_version` equal to `pdd.workflow-status.v1` and a `runs` array, with no human-readable status lines mixed into stdout.

Each run in `runs` has exactly the documented fields `ref`, `repo`, `number`, `workflow`, `area`, `group`, `words`, `prs`, `stories`, `updatedAt`, `root`, `runDir` and `viewCommand`; each PR has `number`, `url` and `state`.
The JSON rows contain the same runs in the same waiting, working, PR-open, done and cancelled ordering as text status; cancelled rows remain hidden unless `--cancelled` is supplied.

A row with no compatible Story evidence has `stories: null`; a row with evidence reports `pass`, `total`, `failing` and any applicable `unknown` or `evidence` fields without changing the status words.
JSON mode writes only the versioned document to stdout; progress and diagnostics stay outside stdout.
